headline: The Duskbloods delayed to 2027
title: The Duskbloods Delayed to 2027 | FromSoftware Switch 2 Exclusive | Gaming News
video_script: FromSoftware has delayed The Duskbloods, its Nintendo Switch two exclusive, from twenty twenty six to twenty twenty seven. The studio announced it on October twenty ninth on the game's official account, saying it needs more time for final adjustments to game rules and balancing after its August network test. No exact date has been given yet. Are you okay with waiting? Comment below!
description: FromSoftware delayed The Duskbloods to 2027, announced October 29, 2026. No exact date yet. Sources: Gfinity Esports, KeenGamer, Siliconera.
joke: At least we get extra time to practice dodging in real life.
